description: Maps Skills full packet fields to Acceleration packet fields for tri-lane consumption
authority_rule: Skills packets are authoritative for allowed_files and acceptance_criteria. Acceleration ai_draft outputs are advisory and superseded by Skills packets.

field_mappings.note: Use Skills allowed_files — more specific (exact filenames, not directory patterns)
Skills forbidden_files is a superset — includes governance paths like .supervisor/policies.yaml, approval-gates.md
Skills uses GAP-* prefix identifier; Acceleration uses capability path string. Both refer to same gap.
Skills acceptance_criteria are pass/fail gates. Acceleration downgrade_rules are advisory warnings. When Skills packet exists, use acceptance_criteria as the gate.
FAIL_CLOSED maps to: no capability matrix update without test evidence; no authority file modification from AI output; all AI outputs must carry ai_draft until human evaluation
Both express the same intent: do not update poc-targets.yaml until tests pass and Supervisor approves
Acceleration does not track execution mode. Skills mode=live means Mainstream will execute against real source.
Acceleration has no rollback concept. Skills rollback_note is for Mainstream worker.

fodt_txt.authority: Skills packet only (no acceleration packet exists for fodt_to_txt_dotnet)

netpbm_pipeline.authority: Skills packet (corrects stale ai_draft selection of flip_diagonal)
